title: bst-markov_ui-and-agg-zero-infima/1 parameter file
description: One member of the Markov family's zero-infima version (constraint-scenarios.md): the infimum of psi or of theta zero, so that the natural limit is 0 in every state and a >= 0 is the natural constraint; the file states no artificial one. Draft.
$comment: This validator checks names, types and ranges. The checker checks the rest: the shared rules and the version's: the infimum of psi or of theta zero, and E[theta^(-rho)] finite, with E[psi^(-rho)] finite when psi's infimum is zero.
